privacy.question: Is my data safe and private?
privacy.answer: Yes, absolutely! All image processing happens locally in your browser. Your images are never uploaded to our servers, ensuring complete privacy and security.

fileSize.question: What's the maximum file size I can compress?
fileSize.answer: You can compress images up to 10MB each. There's no limit on the number of images you can process in a single session.

compression.question: How much can I reduce file sizes?
compression.answer: Compression ratios vary by image type and settings, but typically you can reduce file sizes by 60-90% while maintaining good visual quality.

account.question: Do I need to create an account?
account.answer: No account required! TinyCompressor is completely free to use with no registration, no hidden costs, and no limits.

browsers.question: Which browsers are supported?
browsers.answer: TinyCompressor works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. It's also fully optimized for mobile devices.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: TinyCompressor ('we', 'our', or 'us') is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our image compression service.

informationCollection.title: Information We Collect
informationCollection.content: We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal information. All image processing is performed locally in your browser. We do not have access to your images or any data associated with them.

dataProcessing.title: How We Process Your Data
dataProcessing.content: Your images are processed entirely on your device using client-side JavaScript. No data is sent to our servers or any third parties. This ensures complete privacy and security of your files.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We may use essential cookies to maintain your language preference and improve your experience. We do not use tracking cookies or collect analytics data that could identify you personally.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We do not share your information with third parties. Our service operates independently without external data processing services.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: Since all processing occurs locally on your device, your data never leaves your browser. This provides the highest level of security and privacy protection.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our website.

acceptance.content: By accessing and using TinyCompressor, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement.

description.content: TinyCompressor is a free online image compression tool that allows users to reduce file sizes of images while maintaining quality. All processing is performed locally in your browser.
